plan.notes: Source: official UAMS College of Nursing 'Plans of Study for the Traditional and Accelerated BSN Programs' page (tables with explicit per-course credit hours). Covers the professional nursing phase only; 58 semester hours of general prerequisites are required prior to admission (not sequenced here). GENUINE SOURCE INCONSISTENCY: the page states '62 nursing' credits / 120 total, but its own tables sum to 63 nursing for any real student path: Fall II and Spring II each list two clinical-track options (Adults track: NURS 42136 + NURS 42146; Community/Older-Adult track: NURS 41135 + NURS 42105) and the tracks must swap between terms (the same courses cannot repeat), giving 19+14+1+29 = 63 either way (16+13 or 14+15). total_credits = 65 = sequenced sum using the first-listed option in each choice slot, per the first-listed convention. 'NURS 31146 (Fall semester Rotation 1: July-August)' rotation note preserved in the title.
